collection.description:
Whenever you need somebody …

'I'll Be There'. Sounds like a love song, if it wasn't for the music. Banging techno by ZERO CASH (Television Rocks) and MALENTE (No Brainer). Then again: Banging is not that far from love, is it?

MODEK (Keatchen) loves a good party. His remix nails your hands to the sky and your legs on the floor while shaking your body. Funny how brutal love can be.

LIGHT YEAR (Bang Gang) love the acid. Their raw and uncompromising take on 'I'll Be There' makes you wanna be nothing else but their 808.

KILL FRENZY (Lectroluv) loves bass. He bounces his techno below the surface. I think he might be after some Mermaids with what sounds like sexy sub abuse.

If you're not in love yet MALENTE & ZERO CASH make sure to break your heart with 'Hardware'. Not too many of you will be able to handle the pure amount of adrenaline this tune shoots into your body.

'But don't worry, I'll be there' 



BORIS DLUGOSCH "Light Year is KILLER!!!!! Full support"
BOBMO "I like the Light Year remix and Hardware , thanks!"
BRODINSKI "Love the Light Year rmx! Bigup!"
BAG RAIDERS "This is terrific!!"PUNKS JUMP UP "Love the record! Hardware is our fav!"
SINDEN "Yeah bwoy! The OG works for me. Quirky fun dance music"
TAI "Lovely package. Definitely bunging Modek and Light Year rmx in my next set!"
BENI "Light Year mix is for me"
MUMBAI SCIENCE "Light Year Remix in our sets!"
AC SLATER "Great release. hard to pick a fav track but Kill Frenzy mix sticks out to me. Hardware is crazy with those detuned horns."
DON RIMINI "I play the Modek remix. And the Light Year is crazy ! I love the break in Hardware. Huge tracks!"
DON DIABLO "Light Year mix = fire!"
MASON "It's mad, disturbing, troubled. Thank you"

user.description:
NO BRAINER RECORDS is home to the finest forward thinking club music around and definitely more a state of mind than a record label. We're sowing seeds of excitement on todays dancefloors by using ingredients lifted from a better future. 

It sure wasn't on purpose, but seems we found access to the happy end dimension. Jolly good. So you can buy without wasting any thought. Lucky you.

Brain behind No Brainer is no other than DJ & Producer MALENTE who - with recent releases on labels like FOOL'S GOLD, DIM MAK, EXPLOITED and SOUTHERN FRIED as well as over ten years of experience producing records - certainly doesn't know what he's doing.
 
MALENTE
Senior Manager
Heads off A&R

collection.description:
This album is ‘You Light Up My Life’ which is my 53rd Album and continues with more classic dance hits across the genres and generations and contains music from 1971 to 2013. So, there is something in it for everyone…
					
‘Together Forever’ is a song recorded by English singer-songwriter Rick Astley and released by RCA and BMG as the fourth single from his debut album, ‘Whenever You Need Somebody’ (1987). 

‘Never Gonna Give You Up’ is a pop song by English singer Rick Astley, released on 27 July 1987. Written and produced by Stock Aitken Waterman, it was released as the first single from Astley's debut studio album, ‘Whenever You Need Somebody’.

‘Wake Me Up’ is a song by Swedish DJ and record producer Avicii, released as the lead single from his debut studio album ‘True’ on 17 June 2013. 

‘Ain't No Sunshine’ is a song by Bill Withers, from his 1971 debut album ‘Just As I Am’ and produced by Booker T. Jones.

‘The Lazy Song’ is a song by American singer-songwriter Bruno Mars for his debut studio album, ‘Doo-Wops & Hooligans’ and released on February 15, 2011.

‘I Need More of You’ is a song written by David Bellamy and recorded by American country music duo The Bellamy Brothers. It was released in January 1985 as the third single from the album ‘Restless’. 

‘Blame It On The Fire In My Heart’ is a song by American country music duo The Bellamy Brothers. It was released in January 1992 from the album ‘Beggars and Heroes’. 

‘Matrimony’ is a song by Gilbert O’Sullivan and was released in August 1971 from the album ‘Himself’. 

‘Leave a Light On’ is a song by American singer Belinda Carlisle, recorded for her third studio album ‘Runaway Horses’ released on Sept 25, 1989. 

‘Dreams’ is a song by the British American rock band Fleetwood Mac, written and sung by Stevie Nicks for the band's eleventh studio album, ‘Rumours’ and released on 24 March 1977.

‘Me and You and a Dog Named Boo’ is the March 1971 debut single by Lobo. Written by Lobo under his real name Kent LaVoie, it appears on the ‘Introducing Lobo’ album.

‘Sky High’ is a song by British band Jigsaw. It was released as a single in 1975 and was the main title theme to the film ‘The Man from Hong Kong’. The song was a worldwide hit in the latter part of 1975, reaching No. 3 on the Billboard Hot 100. 

‘If You Think You Know How to Love Me’ is a song by British rock band Smokie. It was first released in June 1975 as a single and appeared on the album ‘Changing All the Time’. 

‘Fast Car’ is the debut single by American singer-songwriter Tracy Chapman, released on April 6, 1988, as the lead single from her 1988 self-titled debut studio album.

‘Lost in France’ is a song recorded by Welsh singer Bonnie Tyler. It was released as a single in September 1976 by RCA Records, written by her producers and songwriters Ronnie Scott and Steve Wolfe. 

‘In These Arms’ is a song by American rock band Bon Jovi, released on May 3, 1993, as the third single from the band's fifth studio album, ‘Keep the Faith’ (1992). 

‘Baby I'm A Want You’ is the fourth album by Bread, released in Jan 1972. Its singles included the title cut which reached No. 3 on the Billboard Top 100. 

‘Magic Woman Touch’ is a song by The Hollies released in 1972 from their studio Album ‘A Selection’

‘A Little Peace’ is a song recorded by German singer Nicole, with music composed by Ralph Siegel and German lyrics written by Bernd Meinunger. It represented Germany in the Eurovision Song Contest 1982.

‘I Have Always Loved You is a song by Enrique Iglesias released in 1999 from the album ‘Enrique’.

‘You Light Up My Life’ is the first solo album from singer Debby Boone released on Jun 15, 1977, and reached No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

So, despite all my health issues and challenges, I present to you a timeless Album filled with nostalgic hits of the past and present. 

Music Videos for this album is on YouTube…link is below:
www.youtube.com/@ONeillFernandes

Enjoy!!!
collection.title: You Light Up My Life

Music is my passion from the time I was born....always been involved in some way, shape or form...from a Hi-Fi enthusiast to a Mobile DJ to a Composer, Guitarist and Producer....all self-taught, which makes it even more special... 

My goal is to make good music and send it out for the world to enjoy...so if you are listening to my music...know it is made with much love to bring joy in your life and a smile on your face...Enjoy!!!
